factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement: Net cash used in financing activities €1,194k (2025) vs €4,178k (2024). Dividends paid €0 (2025) vs €1,347k (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period stood at 5.3 million euros, down from 8.2 million euros at the end of 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of cash flows: Cash and cash equivalents €5,266k (2025) vs €8,195k (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Total assets increased to 126.7 million euros from 113.8 million euros, while total liabilities rose to 97.7 million euros from 87.1 million euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of financial position: Total assets €126,700k (2025) vs €113,751k (2024). Total liabilities €97,700k (2025) vs €87,147k (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Total equity increased to 29.0 million euros from 26.6 million euros, yielding an equity ratio of 22.9%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of financial position: Total equity €29,000k (2025) vs €26,604k (2024). Equity ratio 22.9% per key figures.

factual_claims.claim: A notable positive development during the period was the expansion of the group's order book, which grew by 30% to 273.1 million euros at 31 December 2025, up from 209.5 million euros a year earlier.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Order book: €273,060k (2025) vs €209,489k (2024), representing a 30% increase.

factual_claims.claim: This growth was driven by new contracts secured totaling 235.0 million euros and a nearly threefold expansion in the Infrastructure segment order book, supported by major wins including a Rail Baltica main line railway infrastructure contract and road construction projects with the Estonian Transport Administration.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Order book section: New contracts signed €234,994k. Infrastructure segment order book increased nearly threefold. Mentions Rail Baltica and road construction contracts.

factual_claims.claim: Management anticipates increased business volumes for 2026 based on this stronger order book and improved market conditions.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Order book section concludes: Management expects business volumes to increase in 2026 based on the order book and market outlook.
